name: Quote sent
description: Sent with a quote or estimate after scoping, inviting the client to review and raise questions.
subject: Your quote {{quote_number}} from Vitalos
preheader: What is included, the assumptions behind it and what is out of scope.

blocks.text:
Hi {{first_name}},

Thank you for the time spent discussing {{project_name}}. As agreed, here is our quote. It sets out what is included, the assumptions it rests on, what is out of scope and how long it remains valid, so there are no surprises later.
If the scope or any assumption does not match your understanding, tell us and we will revise it. We are also happy to walk through it on a call if that is easier.

name: Invoice sent
description: Sent with a new invoice, giving the amount, due date and a secure link to the invoice.
subject: Invoice {{invoice_number}} from Vitalos
preheader: The amount and due date, with a secure link to the full invoice.

blocks.text:
Hi {{first_name}},

Please find invoice {{invoice_number}} for {{project_name}} at the link below. Payment details are on the invoice itself.

If you need a purchase order number added, or the invoice should go to someone else in your accounts team, reply and we will reissue it.

For your security, our bank details will not change by email. If you ever receive a message saying they have, please check with us through a contact route you already know before making any payment.

name: Payment reminder: friendly
description: Sent shortly before or on the due date as a gentle reminder that an invoice is due.
subject: Friendly reminder: invoice {{invoice_number}}
preheader: The amount and due date are below. Please ignore this if payment is already on its way.

blocks.text:
Hi {{first_name}},

A gentle reminder that invoice {{invoice_number}} is due on {{due_date}}. If payment is already arranged, thank you, and please ignore this email.
If anything is holding it up, such as a missing purchase order or a query on the invoice, let us know and we will help sort it out.

name: Payment reminder: overdue
description: Sent when an invoice has passed its due date without payment.
subject: Invoice {{invoice_number}} is now overdue
preheader: Please let us know if there is a query, or if payment is already on its way.

blocks.text:
Hi {{first_name}},

Our records show that invoice {{invoice_number}}, due on {{due_date}}, has not yet been paid. It is now {{days_overdue}} days overdue, and we would be grateful if you could arrange payment as soon as possible.

If you have paid in the last few days, thank you; please send the remittance details so we can match the payment. If something is holding it up, reply and tell us, and we will work through it with you.

name: Payment reminder: final notice
description: Sent when an invoice remains unpaid after earlier reminders, stating the next step neutrally.
subject: Final notice: invoice {{invoice_number}}
preheader: Please arrange payment, or talk to us so we can agree a way forward.

blocks.text:
Hi {{first_name}},

Despite our earlier reminders, invoice {{invoice_number}} remains unpaid. It was due on {{due_date}} and is now {{days_overdue}} days overdue.

We value our relationship with {{organisation}} and would much rather resolve this directly. Please arrange payment, or reply to tell us when it will be made or whether there is a query we need to address.
If we do not hear from you, we may need to pause work and refer the matter on.

name: Payment received
description: Sent to the client to confirm a payment has been received, for their records.
subject: Payment received for invoice {{invoice_number}}
preheader: Thank you. This email confirms receipt for your records.

blocks.text:
Hi {{first_name}},

We have received your payment for invoice {{invoice_number}}. Thank you for settling it.
Please keep this email for your records. If your finance team needs a formal receipt or a statement of account, reply and we will send one.
